objective: Remove both exact-reference acquisition and whole-normalized-reference reconstruction from the ratio-overlap successor path by constructing a response from a few prompt-visible carrier tokens plus provably novel private-use characters.

strict_improvement_over.reason: The prior reduction still takes the complete normalized reference as constructor input. This component takes only the visible prompt, visible percentage, and the two co-constraint descriptions observed in the pinned public ratio-overlap family.

mathematical_construction.safe_overlap_atoms: Every character trigram wholly internal to a prompt-visible base token is preserved under arbitrary whitespace-run changes around that token.
mathematical_construction.safe_nonoverlap_atoms: A trigram containing a private-use character selected absent from the visible prompt cannot occur in a reference formed from that prompt's base text under the public combine-with-constraint construction invariant.
mathematical_construction.set_control: Because the frozen scorer uses SET character trigrams, filler length changes the denominator without multiplicity effects; deterministic search chooses A/(A+B) inside the requested plus-or-minus-2 band.
co_constraint_composition: sentence:keyword is satisfied by constructing exactly N punctuation-delimited sentences and placing the visible keyword in sentence N
words:consonants is satisfied by selecting a visible carrier token with an adjacent consonant cluster; the no-whitespace witness is one checker word
